whoItsFor: Mac users on Apple Silicon running macOS 14 or later who want to find files by their content (photos, PDFs, recordings, videos, and code) using on-device search.
useCases: Find a photo or screenshot by describing what it shows, such as 'a dog on the beach'
Jump to the exact moment in a video or podcast recording where a topic comes up
Find a clause in a PDF or a function in your code by describing what it does
